ops.oldText: Contractor reserves the right to change rates with 30 days notice to Company.
ops.newText: Rates set forth in a Statement of Work are fixed for the duration of that Statement of Work. Thereafter, Contractor may increase rates no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, effective no earlier than sixty (60) days after written notice to Company, and no such increase shall exceed the lesser of (i) the percentage increase in the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI-U, All Items) over the preceding twelve (12) months and (ii) three percent (3%).

input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement runs on an evergreen term, so we have added predictability to pricing: rates are fixed for the duration of each Statement of Work and any later increase is capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% with 60 days' notice, consistent with our position that continuing engagements be priced predictably. If helpful, we can accept a 5% cap as a fallback.
input.summary: Cap Contractor's unilateral rate increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%, once per 12 months, with 60 days' notice; rates fixed during each SOW.
